title: Actual integral and strict finite restriction arrows with quotient normalization
statement: Using the canonical supported ordinary quotient towers, marked descent and sections maps [def-sfb-supported-integral-model-tower-data], define the actual integral restriction arrow functor on the full category of finite constant scalar models. Define the finite restriction arrow by deriving sections restriction on strict etale module towers and then applying total derived inverse limit to both endpoints. A natural arrow isomorphism is normalized at its source when, after the actual etale/pro-etale comparison and the marked quotient identification, its source map equals the canonical map from integral derived sections to the entire strict quotient tower derived limit. Every construction is natural in all actual module maps.
